notes: Draft configuration: Historical layout retains the angular northwestern inner return and stepped southwestern inner corner from the pinned 2020 public snapshot, including independently mapped former raceway connections. The northeastern extension is included for extended entries and excluded for the intermediate entry. The source labels these former raceway branches as disused; they are used only to represent the historical course. The series venue history identifies the original circuit and later extensions; supplied branch identity distinguishes this layout. Exact coordinates remain unchanged. Both extended names share this mapped route; their small recorded difference remains unrepresented and requires alignment review. Pit alternatives excluded. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3336.5 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 78 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
